source.title: Enhancing Zero-Shot Crypto Sentiment With Fine-Tuned Language Model and Prompt Engineering
source.citation: Rahman S M Wahidur et al., 2023
source.authors: Rahman S M Wahidur; Ishmam Tashdeed; Manjit Kaur; Heung-No Lee

record.tranche_reason: The study compares downstream classification accuracy across three FLAN-T5 model sizes, including untuned and instruction-tuned conditions. This bears on downstream performance versus scale, but it does not measure pretraining loss or reproduce the original scaling-law method.
record.gate_note: The paper gives a cross-entropy loss formula but reports no measured cross-entropy loss, pretraining token or compute sweep, or compute-optimal allocation result. Its references to scaling and compute-optimal training are background discussion, not its own results. The relevant results are FLAN-T5 accuracy comparisons across model sizes in Table 6 and the reported averages.
record.test_reason: The study's own comparisons across three FLAN-T5 sizes and six fine-tuning dataset sizes bear on V6 in cryptocurrency sentiment classification. They show conditional improvements and failures of improvement with scale, although no predictive scaling function is fitted or validated.
record.authors_conclusion: The record accurately captures the authors' model-size interpretation and reported tuned means. Qualify their claim that tuning harms small-model generalization: the small model declines on Reddit and Cryptocurrency sentiment but improves on Bitcoin and in its overall mean. The proposed capacity explanation is speculative. The authors also conclude that 6,000 fine-tuning examples perform best for each tested model and that short, simple instructions outperform long, complex instructions.
record.recipe_differences: The study measures zero-shot sentiment-classification accuracy after fine-tuning across three model sizes; it does not measure held-out pretraining cross-entropy, fit power laws, or optimize a parameter-token split under a fixed compute budget.
record.method_sensitivity: Results vary with model size and fine-tuning condition; the small model behaves differently from the base and large models.

fits_no_version.finding: Additional instruction tuning changes accuracy at fixed model size, including reducing the small model's Reddit and Cryptocurrency sentiment accuracy from 51.43% to 49.46%.
fits_no_version.proposed_claim: The benefit of additional instruction tuning depends on model size and evaluation dataset; fixed-size tuning effects alone do not establish downstream scaling.

record.problems: The relevant scale comparison covers only three FLAN-T5 sizes and one sentiment-classification task across three datasets. It reports accuracy rather than pretraining loss and provides no uncertainty estimates or fitted scaling relation. The paper states that experiments were repeated but gives no repetition counts or error estimates for these results.

untested.parts: Held-out pretraining loss and its power-law dependence on parameters, tokens, or compute.
Fitting small-run power laws and testing predictions on substantially larger runs.
Loss-minimising parameter-token allocation under fixed compute budgets.
Architecture comparisons at fixed parameter count.
Power-law form in fine-tuning, transfer, or another modality; varying fine-tuning data without testing a power-law form does not establish this version.
A fitted or prospectively validated relationship predicting downstream performance; relationships to measured pretraining loss; generality beyond cryptocurrency sentiment classification.
Dependence of fitted exponents or compute-optimal allocations on setup and fitting choices, and departures from a fitted single power law.

missing.what: Record the fine-tuning data sweep as model-by-sample-size results. At 2K, 4K, 6K, 8K, 10K, and 12K, average zero-shot accuracies are DistilBERT: 54.58%, 56.54%, 66.64%, 57.83%, 55.93%, 58.26%; MiniLM: 63.03%, 69.08%, 69.67%, 66.82%, 54.58%, 59.72%; FLAN-T5-Base: 58.51%, 60.27%, 61.16%, 60.89%, 61.04%, 60.93%. These are increases in fine-tuning examples, not pretraining tokens or fixed-compute comparisons.

record.verdict_notes: No uncertainty estimates or validated scaling predictions are reported. Table 6 conflicts with Tables 3-4 on tuned FLAN-T5-Base accuracy; the verdicts use Table 6 consistently. Aggregate rows are summaries of the dataset rows, not independent evidence. Fine-tuning itself does not disqualify these scale comparisons: downstream accuracy is the claimed outcome, and comparisons across size or data remain relevant.

versions.untested_parts: No held-out pretraining loss or power-law relationship in parameters, tokens, or compute is measured.
No power-law fit or extrapolation from smaller runs is evaluated.
No fixed-compute allocation between parameters and tokens is tested.
No comparison isolates depth, width, or other architecture details at fixed parameter count.
No power-law form is tested in other modalities or training regimes.

The study measures sentiment-classification accuracy for three FLAN-T5 sizes, not performance across a broad downstream task suite or its relationship to pretraining loss. It does not test whether performance follows a predictable scaling law.
The study does not fit scaling exponents or compare how fitting choices affect them or compute-optimal allocation.
